name: Elizabeth Gasque
bio: a Representative from South Carolina; born Elizabeth Mills Hawley on February 26, 1886, near Blythewood, on Rice Creek Plantation, Richland County, S.C.; attended South Carolina Coeducational Institute, Edgefield, S.C.; graduated from Greenville Female College, Greenville, S.C., 1907; elected as a Democrat to the Seventy-fifth Congress to fill the vacancy caused by the death of her husband, Allard H. Gasque, (September 13, 1938-January 3, 1939); was not a candidate for election to the Seventy-sixth Congress; author; lecturer; died on November 2, 1989, in Cedar Tree Plantation, Ridgeway, S.C.; interment at Mount Hope Cemetery, Florence, S.C.
